entries.title: Psalms 125:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The rod - Their power and authority. Not rest - Not continue long. The lot - Upon the habitations and persons of good men. Lest - Lest they should be driven to indirect courses to relieve themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 125:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Lead them - Unto sinful courses. Israel - Upon the true Israel of God.
